notes.title: Version 1.11 Update
notes.content:
1. With the help of “James the Cheapskate”, the English text was polished.
2. Fixed a BUG that sometimes can't click to select troops in the battlefield.

notes.title: Version 1.10 Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637599/cd35c743aa9446f1a956f478537a57e93eebbec5.png[/img]
1. My friends, I have fulfilled my promise. With the help of artister player Tang Ji, all the unit models in the game have been redrawn, and the corresponding map chess pieces have also been adjusted.

2. The performance of fight animation has been improved.

3. The portraits of some commanders have been adjusted.

4. As a result of model adjustment, the number of guns of Star Fort has been reduced from 6 to 4, but the damage and hit of Fort guns have been increased.

In addition, the English text used to be terrible when the game first issued, but it has been improved with the help of steam player Siodog. The current English version, except for a few words without the plural suffix, is perfect. Players who play games in English version don't have to worry about reading problems.

Since this game version, the large updates of Chaos Sector have come to an end. But I have a big news to tell you. Next year(2019), I intend to develop a completely new game with the same story background of Chaos Sector. In this new work, I want to learn from the Total War series. There will be more than 10 optional factions, more than 100 army units and more than 50 legendary commanders. Each faction will have a series of different characteristics: exclusive commanders, exclusive units, exclusive technology and faction quests. There will also be two different parts of space war and planetary assault. The new game will inherit some of the methods used in the space war part of the Chaos Sector, but the strategy and internal affairs will be completely re-structured.

The friends who had added this game into the wishlist, if you are interested in the new game of next year and the story of this world, and haven't bought the Chaos Sector, I hope you to buy Chaos Sector to experience this series of stories and support me to complete the new game. Thank you very much!

Let's meet again in the second half of 2019!

Han Zhiyu

notes.title: Version 1.09 Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637599/3f1cf6d5584f3ffeb3baf79af84499c590ee216f.png[/img]
1. A more Pixel-style font has been replaced and the display for various languages has been improved.
2. All UI have been replaced ( about 100 ! )
3. The Imperial Crusade Faction has added a new commander, Selena, who is extremely powerful. It will take a bit of trouble to get her collection.
4. The weekly-autosave function has been added. your admiral is no longer afraid of losing their game-progress!
5. Adjust the size of the selection direction button, add the sound effect for the born of the troops . Many of other optimizations will not be described in detail.
6. Fixed some bugs that may cause game jam or abnormal display.

Future update:
a artist friend will help me replace all units' fight models with cooler new models! In addition, I also intend to adjust the current too slow fight animation and add support for the keyboard and controller.

notes.title: Version 1.08 Update
notes.content:
1. Fixed a BUG that might appear after the player's troops moved or when player choosing the direction.
2. adjust the enemy level-formul to reduce the enemy's level.

Next month's big update notice:
Add support to keyboard and controller. Replace large amounts of art resources such as models, interfaces and fonts. Add the function of weekly Autosave.

notes.content:
1. The optimization of mouse manipulation has been completed. Now all cancelable functions can be canceled by the right mouse button. The weapons, abilitys and status of the troops can be viewed detailed information by mouse hover.
2. After the battle fails, you can choose to refight, and the battle will return to the initial stage.

Forecast for next Update:
Spanish version (probably)
Update in the future：
Add support to controller, and enhance the performance of all kinds of art.

notes.title: Chaos Sector officially released!
notes.content:
Welcome! In this work, I spent 14 months independently completing all the designing, programming, art, and publicity work. Here is my heart and soul, a dream for the many strategy games that I played enthusiastically in my youth.
I hope you will like it.
Two important things: 
1. The language button on lower left corner of the start scene can switch Chinese and English; 
2, the fight panel can open or close fight animation.
The most important thing is, if you have any suggestions and found any bug, please be sure to tell me that I will fix it in the first place. Thank you!

notes.title: The NorthSky Fleet is getting stronger！
notes.content:
Today's update is mainly aimed at improving the experience of Northsky Fleet:
1. The commander Hardshell's talent 'The A.I.',  its effect changed from increasing experience to clearing battle fog.
2. Further reduce the cost of the NorthSky Fleet Units and increase the initial Attribute value of the NorthSky Fleet Commanders. In order to facilitate the NorthSky Fleet to quickly form a large force.
3. Reduce the cost of all technologies.
4. The language setting button in the Start Scene moved to the lower left corner ( it was often blocked by STEAM's TIP when it was in the lower right corner )

P.S. Thanks to the curator of the 真实评测 team, they found a bug caused by the function of skipping the prologue after game clear. This update has fixed the bug.

notes.title: Several game optimizations
notes.content:
Thank the friends in CowLevel and Indienova for your valuable advices.
Today's update:
1. The collectings you get as you first starting a new game will not be displayed.
2. Player's uinit added a data button to show the unit's data.
3. The red grid indicating the attack range is deepened the color.
4. Fixed a bug: after some unit-commands select a target and then go back to the previous step, you cannot select the same target again.
5. At the beginning of the battlefield, the winning and losing conditions will be showed.
6. Troops with bad status will display Bad text on the map model.
7, reduce the cost of build units and reduce the tactical skills's SP.

notes.title: the Chaos Galaxy World
notes.content:
I have invested several years to construct a grand world named Chaos Galaxy. This game Chaos Sector is an important war zone event under this world background.
After the game's release, there are two other things that will begin:
1. The writing of novels of Chaos Galaxy World will been launched. There are chinese publishers have expressed interest in this.
2. Some months after the release of the first game Chaos Sector, a new game in the same world will be launched on a larger scale. It will be a grand strategy game model of numerous characteristic factions as the total war games. Of course, the game art will still be pixel art as this game.
If you can read chinese, the latest development of Chaos Galaxy World will be constantly updated in this site:
https://afdian.net/@hanzhiyu
